{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The U.S. economy is rigged against the American people.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Trump and the Republicans have rewarded big corporations and their wealthy donors, and left working families behind.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will take decisive action to level the playing field for people of color, working families, women, and small business owners.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The tax system has been rigged against the American people by big corporations and their lobbyists, and by Republican politicians.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will reverse the Trump Administration's tax cuts benefiting the wealthiest Americans and rewarding corporations for shipping American jobs overseas.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will crack down on overseas tax havens and close loopholes exploited by the wealthiest Americans and biggest corporations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The wealthy will pay their fair share in taxes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Investors will pay the same tax rates as workers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The carried interest loophole will be ended.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Corporate tax rates, which were cut sharply by the 2017 Republican tax cut, must be raised.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"\"Trickle-down\" tax cuts must be rejected.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Estate taxes should be raised back to the historical norm.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
